# Roy Gardner

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>
- **Origin:** Kingsport  <sub>[v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Roy  <sub>[v3 c25 P43](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0043)</sub>

## Appearance

Roy is described as adorably handsome, with glorious, dreamy dark eyes and a deep, black, velvety smile. He shares a facial resemblance to his sister Dorothy, though she possesses roguish hazel eyes rather than his dark eyes.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c25 P48](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0048), [v3 c26 P19](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0019), [v3 c36 P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024)_

## Personality

Roy is polite, cultured, and possesses an unfailing and deferential courtesy. He wooed Anne in a highly romantic, poetic, and flawless manner. Despite his charm and cleverness, he can react bitterly or look foolish when his expectations are shattered.

_Sources: [v3 c26 P19](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0019), [v3 c38 P17](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0017), [v3 c38 P19](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0019), [v3 c38 P27](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0027)_

## Goals

- To court and marry Anne Shirley  <sub>[v3 c26 P19](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0019), [v3 c38 P17](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0017)</sub>

## History

Royal Gardner was forced to pause his college studies for two years to travel abroad with his ailing mother. After returning to his studies, he met Anne Shirley in the park during a rainstorm when her umbrella turned inside out, rescuing her with his own. He immediately began courting her by sending long-stemmed roses, accompanied by poetic lines. Over two years, Roy pursued Anne with romantic gestures, sending orchids to her receptions and visiting her regularly at Patty's Place. He eventually took Anne to the seaside pavilion on the harbor shore where they had first talked and proposed to her with carefully chosen words. When Anne unexpectedly rejected his proposal because she did not love him, Roy was stunned and deeply hurt, stating that she had ruined his life before bidding her a final farewell.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P42](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0042), [v3 c25 P44](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0044), [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c26 P1](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0001), [v3 c26 P19](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0019), [v3 c38 P17](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0017), [v3 c38 P18](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0018), [v3 c38 P27](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0027), [v3 c38 P32](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0032)_
